_comment: Known shadcn-based component registries this bundle can detect and route to. Each entry is one 'brand' — Fission's own design system, or (later) a client's own private registry. Adding a new client's design system here, plus one file under references/adapters/registries/<id>.md, is the whole integration: no change to the detector script or the 10 ds-* skills is needed.

registries.label: Fission UI (FissionHQ/ui-design-system)
registries.ponytail_note: component list duplicated (in sync, not shared) with plugins/fl-design-system/references/component-catalog.md on purpose — keeps this plugin installable standalone with no cross-plugin path dependency. Update both if Fission's registry adds/removes a component.
